title: Rule hits
lede: Every time a guard rule fired at a till or an online check, with the patient, payer, store and what happened next. Download the window as Excel for the payer's review. The rows carry national IDs.

access.deniedHint: Ask for the insurance rule hits grant to read the rule hits.

window.label: Window
window.invalid: Pick a real start and end date.
window.reversed: The end date is before the start date.
window.tooLong: Pick a window of 93 days or less.
window.outOfBounds: The window is outside the days the hits keep.

empty: No rule fired in this window with these filters.
failed: The rule hits could not be read.
downloadFailed: The Excel could not be downloaded.
